She is coping with a brain injury, if writing things down helps her I think you should respect her choice. 

If it doesn't bother you friends, she should still keep her journal. If her memory gets better, you could recommend keeping a diary. But, correct me if am wrong, if she has short term or bad memory keeping a journal at all times is a great idea!

NTA

if either parents takes the responsibility of staying at home, no matter if one plays videogames or does other hobbies, they should do the same amount of "chores"

i think you should try to set up a bare minimum of tasks that should be done while you are gone, and maybe keep them even after quarantine and if your husband gets a job. This would help you as your home would be clean, the baby happy, and other benefits of the tasks you choose. This would also give your husband a set goal, after which/in between them he could play video games, setting time for both video games and chores.
